newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit recovers, but gains seen limited.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit recovers, but gains seen limited.

text.p: * Ringgit recovers but gains seen limited due to firmness in dollar/majors
* Trading range expected to remain tight due to fears of Bank Negara intervention
The ringgit recovered against the dollar in choppy early Asian trading, but dealers said they expected ringgit gains to be limited.

"There's little buying interest for ringgit while the dollar remains well bid by offshore players," said a dealer at a large Malaysian bank. "Dollar/ringgit may test 2.5250 again and possibly a minor break to 2.5270."
He said dollar/ringgit would be supported by the strength in dollar/majors.
But dollar gains were likely to be capped by fears of central bank intervention.
Bank Negara is said to have checked on rates on Monday, after intervening on Friday to sell around $100 million to support the ringgit at 2.5250 a dollar.
At 0230 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5233/43 to a dollar. It closed at 2.5245/55 in Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
